Fig. 2. (A) Sequence similarity network (SSN) analysis of the LanB homologs (e-value: 80). Colors in the nodes show PSL family PTs from different classes of 
taxonomy according to the legend. Edges (lines) indicate that pairwise alignments of nodes are better than the cutoff value. GczB, GczC, SazB-PT, NozPT, DmtC1, 
LdqG, NzsG, CqsB4 and LanB are marked in red circles. (B) Organization of the lan gene cluster in Streptomyces sp. 4-L-3. (C) HPLC traces of the fermentation extracts 
of (i) cWW standard; (ii) BL21/pET28a::lanA; (iii) BL21/pET28a, UV detection at 300 nm. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this figure legend, the 
reader is referred to the web version of this article.)
